title: Your Phone Fell in Water. Now What?
summary: Your phone just slipped into the sink. What you do in the next minute matters more than any trick. Here's what really helps.

beats.text: Splash! Your phone just fell in the sink. Rice, turn it off, or charge it: what do you do first?
Most people do the wrong thing here, and it can cost them the phone.

beats.reveal: Turn it off! Power plus water inside is what really breaks things.

beats.text: Then take off the case, wipe it dry, and let it air dry, port facing down.
And wait before charging. A full day is safest.
And the rice trick? Phone makers now say skip it. Bits of rice can get stuck in the port.

visual.text: Rice doesn't help, and bits can get stuck inside.
